facts.value: The California High School Proficiency Examination and other high school equivalency diplomas are recognized as high school diplomas.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: Students should submit their diploma to show completion of high school, but will also need to submit additional high school transcripts or SAT or ACT scores to satisfy course competency and aptitude requirements for admission.
facts.programme_association: Organizational Leadership (Military and Veterans Studies) - BA

facts.value: Alternatively, enrollment and successful completion of 24 semester credits with a 2.75 minimum GPA through Earned Admission, or completion of 24 or more college credits from a regionally accredited college or university with a minimum of 2.50 cumulative GPA on a 4.00 scale may be used to satisfy requirements for admission.
